# `morphir mck package mvp-report render`

- **Usage:** `morphir mck package mvp-report render <-o --output <FILE>> <REPORT>`

Render a standalone offline HTML view of a versioned MVP report

## Arguments
- **`<REPORT>`** — Versioned local Library MVP JSON report

## Flags
- **`-o --output <FILE>`** — Standalone HTML output file; cannot overwrite the JSON input
